lines.t: Neon veins in a glass‑sky night
Constellations spell my little plans in light
I trace my will in ultraviolet dust
‘Til Your voice cuts through like a holy thrust
Supernovas in my fractured mind
I’ve been orbiting the gravity of “mine”
But every star I chase turns cold and dim
Then I hear the ancient echo, calling me to Him
I held the cup of my own desire
Silver illusions, counterfeit fire
Then the heavens split, and a higher sound
Said, “Lay it down… lay it down…”
[Drop – EDM / Psychedelic]
(Chopped vox)
Not my will… Yours alone…
Galaxies bow… before Your throne…
Flesh falls silent… Spirit sings…
Every crown… for the Cosmic King…
I see a Garden at the edge of time
Where the Infinite steps into the finite line
The Cup glows dark with a crimson storm
Yet the Lion wears a broken‑Lamb form
He tastes the terror in the human soul
Yet bends the universe to one pure goal
No split will, no divided throne
Just perfect Love choosing pain alone
Your will is the axis all worlds spin around
Your word is the pattern in quantum ground
Man builds towers of electric sand
You write galaxies in a single hand
Our wisdom flickers like a dying star
Your wisdom burns where the Throne‑rivers are
I drank deep dreams from a fractured sea
I called chains “freedom”, thought I was free
Then Your thunder rolled through my inner sky
And every idol melted in Your cry
[Drop 2 – Bigger / Mystical]
(Chopped vox, layered)
Not my will… let it die…
Raise me up… in Your design…
Every “why”… dissolves in light…
When Your will… rewrites my night…
Now my prayers ride comets through the dark
They all burn out in Your blazing heart
I begin where every storyline ends
In the will of the Lord that no mind comprehends
